이 영상은 신인 걸그룹 리센느(RESCENE)가 출연하여 '고품격 K-POP 동아리'라는 콘셉트로 다양한 활동을 펼치는 예능 콘텐츠입니다. 주요 내용은 다음과 같습니다.

자기소개 및 캐릭터 설정 (0:43 - 8:46): 멤버들은 각각 실용음악과, 심리학과, 항공과, 실용무용과, 요정학과 소속으로 자신을 소개하며 롤모델을 밝히고, 장기자랑으로 춤과 노래 실력을 선보입니다.
엔딩 요정 훈련 (9:15 - 17:21): '고품격 엔딩 요정'이 되기 위해 와사비, 고삼차, 미숫가루 등을 먹고도 평온한 표정을 유지해야 하는 혹독한(?) 미션을 수행합니다. 멤버들은 각자의 개성 있는 엔딩 포즈를 완성합니다.
가창 영상 촬영 (17:41 - 22:15): 멤버 리브가 노래를 부르고, 동아리 부원들이 함께 엔딩 포즈를 연습하며 팀워크를 다집니다.
활동 마무리 (22:56 - 25:20): 동아리 활동일지를 작성하며 소감을 나누고, 멤버들 간의 끈끈한 우정을 확인하며 밝게 마무리합니다.

One reason I like RESCENE’s music is that every member contributes according to her own unique ability. Minami and Liv are clearly the two main vocalists; Minami acts as "the voice" of the group with her powerful R&B style, while Liv’s beautiful falsetto flows like water through her free improvisations.

However, the other members play equally vital roles, even if their parts seem less flashy. Woni and May possess unique timbres that are immediately recognisable. While they may have fewer lines in a traditional sense, their delivery is incredibly effective during the performance's quieter moments. I also love how they support the main vocalists, adding a richness to the overall sound.

Finally, Zena deserves huge applause. In a football team, she would be the central midfielder, linking the attackers (Minami and Liv) with the wingers (Woni and May). Zena has a sweet yet stable and powerful voice; she provides the melodic foundation that Woni and May rely on, and which allows Minami and Liv the freedom to express themselves. Her role as a lead singer is just as essential as the more prominent parts.

I absolutely adored this rock version of Run Away. Well done to the girls, the band, and the entire production team!
